topic: Constructional details about Dornier A/C propeller, construction of blades and pitch change mechanism and spinner
syllabus_extract: Constructional details about Dornier A/C propeller, construction of blades and pitch change mechanism and spinner
specific_objectives: 7.1.2.1 Trainee will be able to explain propellers and its associated maintenance practice

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list

practical: Review of propeller construction diagrams; Safety: Ensure no loose pins or tools; Supervision: Instructor verifies diagram interpretation
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an aircraft propeller?
Name two types of propellers used in modern aviation.
How does a propeller generate thrust?

development.content:
General construction of Dornier propeller
Blade construction and materials
Hub assembly and attachment
Pitch change mechanism components
Hydraulic pitch control system

Spinner construction and purpose
Blade pitch adjustment procedures
Maintenance checks for pitch mechanism
Common defects in propeller blades
Lubrication points and intervals

Propeller balance and vibration causes
Inspection criteria for blade integrity
Storage and handling precautions
Record keeping for maintenance actions
Reporting defects to maintenance unit

summary_questions: Explain the role of the pitch change mechanism in variable pitch propellers.
Describe the key maintenance checks required for propeller blades.
What are the immediate actions if a propeller imbalance is detected?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the differences between fixed pitch and variable pitch propellers, referencing the maintenance practices discussed in LP 02.
